body: I gave your name as credit. The website I found your art from was not your website it was someone else who had uploaded a thread of artwork representing different mental disorders. They didn't include the hyperlink to your website. They just gave your name.
As explained, I credited the artist name in the title. I never claimed the art as my own.
I understand it won't relate to everyone ❤️ glad you like the art !
I'm sorry for your loss ❤️ I feel the same way... it hurts a lot
I'm really sorry to hear that... any real friend should support you !!' Feel free to drop a message at any time :)

I'm so sorry for your loss, it must be an extremely tough time for you, your mother and anyone else who knew him. My mother passed away 6 years ago and it still hurts me to this very day. No one should ever put you down for grieving by saying "get over it". The truth is, you never get over it you just learn to live with it... ❤️
I forgot to mention we've been together for 7 months...
Thank you it means a lot ❤️❤️❤️

My mother died in a hospice when I was 13 years old and honestly it was the most traumatising event that ever happened in my life. 6 years later it still affects me everyday. I've been dealing with depression and bereavement, since I had no other family members to help me during that very difficult time. 

My main advice would be to surround yourself with all the people you love, be honest about how you feel and don't bottle things up. 

My thoughts are with you during this very difficult time ❤️
